title: Mass of a conditioned transcript fiber
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $p$ be a deterministic protocol for disjointness on inputs of length $n$, and let $z$ be an achievable value of $Z=(M,T,X_{<T},Y_{>T})$. Write $D$ for the hard distribution conditioned on the generated input sets being disjoint, and let $D'$ be $D$ further restricted to samples for which Bob's bit at the special coordinate is false. Then the $D'$-mass of the fiber of $Z$ at $z$ is $\frac{3}{2}$ times the $D$-mass of the intersection of that fiber with the event that Bob's special-coordinate bit is false.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a deterministic protocol for disjointness on inputs of length $n$
$z$ is an achievable value of $Z$ for $p$
replaced:
Fix a positive length $n$ and a deterministic communication protocol $p$ for
disjointness inputs of length $n$, and let $z$ be an achievable value of the variable
$Z=(M,T,X_{<T},Y_{>T})$ for $p$, with fiber $Z^{-1}(z)$. Write $D$ for the hard
distribution conditioned on the generated input pair being disjoint, and let $D'$ be $D$
conditioned further on the event $\{Y_T=\mathrm{false}\}$ that Bob's bit at the special
coordinate $T$ is $\mathrm{false}$. Then
\[
D'\big(Z^{-1}(z)\big) \;=\; \frac{3}{2}\, D\big(\{Y_T=\mathrm{false}\}\cap
Z^{-1}(z)\big).
\]
